provenance: Preserved output of the completed read-only whole-corpus candidate check in this task. This file was saved afterward without rerunning the check. Exact execution timestamp was not captured.
mode: READ ONLY REPEATABLE READ source snapshot; sentence candidates computed only in memory; no DB publication, embedding or generation

method.source: Active native records joined to records.current_version with payload.retrievable=true, loaded through Settings/Database in one explicit read-only repeatable-read transaction and released before candidate computation.
method.progress: For every pair of successive chunks in each record, require next.start > previous.start and next.end > previous.end.
method.tokens: Require 0 < stored candidate token_count == cl100k_base recomputation <= 600.
method.ranges: Every candidate must fit wholly inside one declared retained source interval.
method.coverage: The union of candidate source intervals must cover every nonwhitespace character in every declared retained interval.

limits: The production chunks were not replaced; the current production snapshot had 558 chunks.
This checks engineering integrity of sentence candidates, not retrieval or answer quality.

sentence_boundary_comparison.method: Recompute the original audit algorithm independently on each full retained interval: split blank paragraphs/form feeds, one-whitespace-character to one-space view, English pySBD clean=False char_span=True, validate source offsets, trim whitespace. Count sentence_start < trimmed_chunk_end < sentence_end. Not a punctuation heuristic and not segmentation of the already-truncated chunk.
sentence_boundary_comparison.uncovered_span_definition: Every predicted span in every retained interval is checked against every candidate of the same current record version. Count a span once if no individual candidate contains both its start and end, regardless of whether all characters remain covered by multiple candidates.
